in_english.name: Azyraa
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azyraa originates from the Arabic root 'عزز' (azaza), meaning to honor or to exalt. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person of high esteem, respect, and nobility. Etymologically, it is linked to the Quranic concept of 'izza (عزة), which refers to power, glory, and dignity. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person of strong and respectable character. The spiritual significance of Azyraa lies in its representation of moral integrity and elevated status within the community.
